_comment: Reviewed exemptions from scripts/lint-script-negcorpus.js. A script rule of a ledger-category technology whose matches land on registrable domains that are not its vendor's, and do not name the host, fails the gate. An entry exempts one rule up to maxOffDomains (the count when it was reviewed): a rule that gets broader fails again. Classes: self-hosted software path (served first-party, names the software), vendor client bundled first-party, vendor-second-domain (declare _hosts instead), known defect, fix pending (temporary). A stale or no-op entry fails the build.
